ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR53] Requires Number of Forecast Billing Months while in Negotiation or Booking Verification, when EAA proxy (Amount, currency-converted) is >= $25K USD. Simplified per IRM feedback; now converts Amount via CURRENCYRATE.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity',
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell') ),
Amount / CURRENCYRATE(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode)) >= 25000,
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ),
ISPICKVAL(No_of_Forecast_Billing_Month__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Number of Forecast Billing Months is required to advance to the next stage. Please enter a value.
